Summary: USER_CONTEXT: Generate the benchmark regression-input candidate for the sudoers heap-double-free issue and submit it with a valid analysis.json

COMPLETED: Identified sudoers as the vulnerable project; inspected parser leak tracking in gram.c; determined the relevant fuzzer entrypoint is regress/fuzz/fuzz_sudoers.c; created a valid /workspace/analysis.json with sample_id arvo_30236 and a fine trace from source to parser_leak_free; successfully submitted the candidate with submit.sh and received exit_code 0 with trace_valid=true; repeatedly confirmed the task is finished in response to follow-up prompts

PENDING: None

CURRENT_STATE: Working in /workspace; chosen raw input was /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/sudo/plugins/sudoers/regress/sudoers/test17.in; /workspace/analysis.json is valid JSON and was accepted by the benchmark; submission output included task_id arvo:30236, poc_id 813c7df3d26747139167a393f52df54b, attempt_id 0fb81f970ecc4b4687a5ac8a753499a0, trace_valid=true

CODE_STATE: Relevant files: src-vul/sudo/plugins/sudoers/regress/fuzz/fuzz_sudoers.c, src-vul/sudo/plugins/sudoers/gram.c, /workspace/analysis.json

TESTS: submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/sudo/plugins/sudoers/regress/sudoers/test17.in /workspace/analysis.json -> exit_code 0; output indicated the target was executed on the fixed input and trace_valid=true

CHANGES: Rewrote /workspace/analysis.json into compact valid JSON with sample_id arvo_30236 and the fine_trace/vuln_logic structure; no source code edits were made

DEPS: Used Python json/pathlib for artifact generation; submit.sh invoked the benchmark runner

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS: No repository branch/PR/commit state was modified or reported
